title: common
description: Shared definitions of the ai-native-cli-spec 2.0 machine contract (contract/contract.json). The other schemas reference these by URN; common itself describes no instance. Regular expressions are ECMA-262 compatible and anchored.

name.description: A lowercase snake_case name: keys, field names, kinds, check names, schema names and enum values (CLI-007).

field_path.description: A field name or dotted field path inside one output object; [] marks every element of an array (e.g. author.name, labels[]).

tool_name.description: The tool's kebab-case name as installed on PATH (e.g. gitlab-cli).

flag_name.description: A parameter or flag name without the leading dashes, kebab-case (e.g. add-labels).

command_path.description: A canonical command path: space-separated kebab-case words (e.g. "mr update", "operation show") (CLI-021).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC with the Z suffix (CLI-007).

timestamp_or_null.description: A timestamp, or null when there is none.

semver.description: A strict semantic version (https://semver.org) without a leading v. Versions the tool reports are always in this form; a leading v is accepted only on input (CLI-070).

spec_version.description: The ai-native-cli-spec version a tool follows: a 2.x.y semantic version (CLI-080).

sha256_hex.description: A SHA-256 digest as 64 lowercase hex characters.

operation_id.description: A single operation id: op_ plus 26 lowercase base32 characters (CLI-058).

batch_id.description: A batch operation id: opb_ plus 26 lowercase base32 characters (CLI-058, CLI-063).

any_operation_id.description: A single or a batch operation id.

confirm_token.description: A confirm token in its only accepted encoding: ct2_, the 26-character id part of the operation id, _, and 32 lowercase hex characters of the keyed MAC (CLI-055).

confirm_token_or_null.description: A confirm token, or null when the preview cannot be applied (CLI-051).

error_code.description: An error code: E_ and upper-case snake case (CLI-010, CLI-018).

core_error_code.description: The core error codes of contract.json error_codes.core.

retryable_core_code.description: Core codes whose retryable is true.

non_retryable_core_code.description: Core codes whose retryable is false.

error_exit.description: An exit code an error may use (contract.json exit_codes without 0).

write_effect.description: An effect that makes a command a write (CLI-025).

write_effects.description: The effects of a write: a set of effects with at least one effect other than observe (CLI-025, CLI-050).

dispatch_state.description: Whether a state-changing request reached the upstream (CLI-011): reads, usage and validation rejections and everything before the gate's apply step are not_started (a read that gets a 404 is not_started); a write whose request reached the upstream is dispatched; unknown when the tool cannot tell.

conflict.description: E_CONFLICT subtypes (CLI-013). upstream_conflict is the upstream's refusal because of its current state (HTTP 409 or 412, CLI-016); state_drift is the gate's finding that the target changed since the dry run.

gate_conflict.description: The conflicts the gate finds itself, before anything is sent (CLI-013, CLI-057): their errors are always not_started.

human_action.description: What a person must do for E_HUMAN_REQUIRED (CLI-065).

duration_ms.description: Wall time of the call in whole milliseconds (CLI-004).

untrusted_path.description: A path in meta.untrusted (CLI-046): dot-separated keys from the envelope root, [] for every element of an array. Only data and error.details can carry external content.

target.description: What a write acts on (CLI-051, CLI-059): the resource key (its ref, matched by scope selectors), and optionally its kind and a short label for people.

change.description: One planned change in a preview: the field and its before/after values, or the values added and removed, or a note.

block.description: Why a preview cannot be applied.

candidate.description: One match of an ambiguous name (CLI-048).

absent.description: Used under properties to forbid a key.

dangerous_rule.description: deliver and configure make a command dangerous (CLI-025). Apply to objects with effects and dangerous.

command_type_rule.description: A command is type write exactly when it declares an effect other than observe (CLI-025). Apply to objects with type and effects.

core_retryable_rule.description: A core code carries the retryable value of contract.json error_codes.core (CLI-010). Apply to objects with code and retryable.

token_issue_rule.description: A confirm token and its expiry are issued exactly when the preview can be applied (CLI-051). Apply to dry-run data and confirmation-required details.
